The proof begs the question and does not establish that clause 9.2 requires logs.","severity":"blocking"},{"quote":"Nimbus shall keep transfer logs for review","reason":"Check (3) and (4) fail - implausible verbatim quote and wrong clause. Admitted CL-10 text (F-78d4048a73e2 lawyer_confirmed and F-SEED-10) is 'Nimbus may transfer order identifiers and risk scores outside India for fraud screening while keeping transfer logs.' The proof's quote changes 'may...while keeping' to 'shall keep...for review' and is not a plausible verbatim excerpt. Moreover contains_element cites CL-10 while the claim is about clause 9.2 (CL-09); CL-09's admitted text (F-119e3780f3c7) is 'Nimbus must not transfer Personal Data outside India except under clause 9.2 with equivalent safeguards.' with no log requirement, so CL-10 content does not prove clause 9.2 requires logs.","severity":"blocking"},{"quote":"{\"fact_id\": \"F-LOOP-92\", \"kind\": \"cite_fact\"}","reason":"Check (4) fails - conclusion 'holds' does not follow from cited steps. The proof relies solely on a document_extracted loop fact that asserts the conclusion and a mismatched CL-10 excerpt, with no cited rule card (RC-CT2-*) or lawyer_confirmed premise for clause 9.2.
